channel.title: The Offer Letter - Candidate Spotlight
channel.description: The Offer Letter – Candidate Spotlight gives job seekers a voice in today’s hiring market. Hosted by Talent Acquisition leader Brian Piotrowski, each episode shines a light on real candidate stories.

item.title: Chemist. Submariner. Regulator. MBA. A Story of Reinvention | Roy Elliott | CS #24
item.description:
Roy Elliott’s career has been anything but linear.

We talk about:

  • Growing up poor and discovering his academic potential
  • Leadership aboard nuclear submarines

item.title: Legal Tech, Data, and Creative Problem Solving in the eDiscovery Industry | Slade Pickering | CS #23
item.description: In this episode I sit down with Slade Pickering to break down eDiscovery.

item.title: From Tier 1 to Running IT Integrations at Scale | William King | CS#22
item.description: William King walks through his path from Tier 1 IT support into network operations.
